strengths.what: Real property photography throughout (facade, lobby, rooms), no stock imagery.
strengths.why: Builds authentic trust for a small independent hotel; keep through any rework.

strengths.what: Live room rates shown directly on the page, scraped from the booking engine.
strengths.why: Removes the 'consultar precio' click most independent hotel sites force; a real conversion asset.

strengths.what: Booking CTA repeats at every scroll depth: sticky nav, hero, rooms, tarifas cards, and a dedicated bottom CTA block.
strengths.why: The action is always one tap away regardless of where a visitor loses interest.

strengths.what: Phone, email, WhatsApp and address are all click-to-act with clear labels.
strengths.why: Low-friction path for visitors who want to talk to a human before booking.

recommendations.opportunity: Add 3-4 real named guest testimonials (name + origin/reason for stay) next to the platform score cards.
recommendations.why: The page shows aggregate numbers only, no face or quote; numbers alone read as a stat, not proof from a real guest.

recommendations.opportunity: Pull the strongest review score (e.g. Booking.com 8.6/479) into the hero, near the CTA.
recommendations.why: Proof currently sits after rooms, gallery and tarifas; a cold visitor decides on the fold with zero social proof in sight.

recommendations.opportunity: Standardize every booking CTA to one button style and one label ("Reservar ahora").
recommendations.why: Three visual styles (navy solid, gold solid, gold outline) and four labels (Reservar, Reservar ahora, Ver disponibilidad, Ver disponibilidad online) currently split the same action across the page.

recommendations.opportunity: Name who the hotel is for (business travelers, couples, families visiting Salta) alongside the location claim.
recommendations.why: The hero states hotel type and address but never who should book it, so it reads generic to a scanning visitor.

recommendations.opportunity: State one concrete reason to pick Wilson over the other 3-star hotels in Salta centro.
recommendations.why: Trayectoria and location are the only claims made; neither differentiates from the many similar downtown hotels.

recommendations.opportunity: Add a short FAQ (check-in flexibility, pet policy, parking, group bookings) before the contact block.
recommendations.why: These are the objections a guest has right before booking; none are answered anywhere on the page today.

recommendations.opportunity: Add a labeled policy row to the footer (privacy, terms, cancellation policy).
recommendations.why: The footer only has social links and a copyright line; nothing reassures a visitor about data or refund terms before they leave the site to book.

recommendations.opportunity: Give the "Último Minuto" plan a real scarcity cue (rooms left, valid through a date) instead of just a discount tag.
recommendations.why: The only urgency signal on the page is a static discount label with no time or availability pressure behind it.

recommendations.opportunity: Trim or consolidate the 12 major sections, or add a persistent mini-nav for long-scroll orientation.
recommendations.why: A page this long risks losing scanners partway down; a lighter structure or better wayfinding reduces drop-off.

recommendations.opportunity: Reframe a few section H2s toward benefit language (e.g. "Tu espacio en el centro" instead of "Nuestros espacios").
recommendations.why: Most H2s are plain section labels; benefit-framed headings scan faster for a visitor comparing hotels.

pageLevel.opportunity: Build one canonical CTA component (one style, one label) and reuse it at all 6+ booking touchpoints.
pageLevel.why: Fixes the CTA-dominance and CTA-wording gaps at the source instead of patching each instance separately.

sectorSpecific.opportunity: Add a short reassurance line that card guarantee and payment happen on the booking engine's own secure page.
sectorSpecific.why: Guests are handed off to an external motor (Winpax) to pay; a small trust nudge before that jump reduces hesitation. Judgment call, not in the rubric.

notes: Industry inferred from content (independent hotel, Salta, AR). No live render available this session (browser extension not connected); visual-mode rubric items were scored from DOM/inline-style evidence where countable (nav, CTA repetition, footer, imagery) and marked n/a where a real screenshot was required (five-second test, color contrast, scannability). Coverage 0.92, evidence-backed 0.51 — treat the band as the honest range.
